As mentioned by Production Champion of Sicharge D in a previous ticket, this problem only applies to the chargers that constantly are clogging the system.
For this ticket, it will only be assessed for charger 0wKjrz since it's the only one affected. All the other are completely fine right now, during a boot up it's normal that more logs come in at once, since if the charger went offline, all the logs must be sent.
We will try to fix the charger ID mentioned above.
Thank you.
Best regards,
Francisco
